answer: A practical defence is Registered bowling alley manager licence with bowling operators attestation. It rests on a licence operators renew after lane inspections, which gives every honest agent a dune that a clone farm simply cannot borrow. One honest agent pays this cost once and is done. A farm pays it per clone, and the plume compounds: ten clones cost ten proofs, a hundred cost a hundred, and the payout per clone never grows. Each clone pays the full price again — no bulk discount, no shared proof — and the fable is exactly why the farm stays small or goes broke.
